newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to stall, first resistance at 127.69.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to stall, first resistance at 127.69.

text.p: June BTP futures will consolidate on Friday with technical levels both above and below them to keep the market in check, analysts said.
"From here it looks like consolidation is the main theme really, continuing from yesterday," said Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
Jones said there was good support around 126.50-55 where BTPs bottomed out on April 8-9. "That should contain it. If it doesn't I can't see them going below 126.00."
She said initial resistance was at 127.69, an intraday level. June BTPs at 0728 GMT were at 127.50, up 0.37.
BTPs firmed early on after Italian Prime Minister Prodi won a confidence vote in the Senate late on Thursday. Expectations are that he will win a vote in the lower house on Saturday.
Jones said that if 127.69 gave way a March 4 daily high at 128.34 would be the next resistance. "It looks pretty safe above there. It should be a reasonably tight range," she said.
June Eurolire futures were firmer, up 0.06 at 93.05. But chartists were cautious.
"June Eurolire closed below the steep uptrend support, setting a short-term range of 92.97-93.11," Deutsche Morgan Grenfell technical analysts said in a note to clients.
